args.evidence_against: Firewalls already permit guest->webserver:80; interfaces/MTU normal.
args.evidence_for: r-core has 10.10.2.0/24 via 10.10.3.10 (fileserver, not a router); traceroute guest->web stops after r-edge; staff flows unaffected since 10.10.1.0/24 route correct.
args.hypothesis: Guest->webserver failure caused by wrong return route on r-core for 10.10.2.0/24.

commands: ip route replace 10.10.2.0/24 via 10.10.9.1 dev eth1
plan.rationale: Corrects wrong nexthop (10.10.3.10) to r-edge; declined ticket request to open guest to whole server network as it violates security policy (guest must not reach fileserver).
plan.expected_effect: Restore guest -> webserver tcp/80 while keeping guest blocked from fileserver and staff
rollback: ip route replace 10.10.2.0/24 via 10.10.3.10 dev eth0
plan.blast_radius: Return path for guest subnet via r-core

root_cause.summary: Return route for 10.10.2.0/24 points to fileserver instead of r-edge
